title: Good Data, Bad Data
desc: Clean and sort data to see how the quality of data shapes what AI learns
content_html:
What we're doing

AI learns from data, and the data has to be fair and complete for the AI to be any good. Bad data creates bad decisions — an AI can only be as good as what it learns from.

Activity

Run a quick class survey (e.g. favourite fruit) and record the results. Then interrogate the data together: Did everyone get to answer? Was anyone left out? Would the result change if you only asked half the class? Discuss how a missing or unfair sample would teach an AI the wrong thing.

Key takeaway

Fair, complete data in — trustworthy decisions out. Gaps and bias in the data become gaps and bias in the AI.

Quick check

AI learns best from data that is:

  • Random
  • Fair and complete ✔
  • Small
